name: DescribeRelatedDefenseRules

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the rule to query
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the protection rule. Only the following value is supported:
global: a global-level rule
parameters.help_zh:
防护规则类型。目前仅支持取值：
global：表示全局维度的规则
parameters.name: defense_type

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token (Token) for the next page. If a next page exists, this field has a return value.

If this parameter has a return value, a next page exists. Use the returned NextToken as a request parameter to obtain the data on the next page. Repeat this process until no value is returned, which indicates that all data has been retrieved
parameters.help_zh:
下一页查询凭证（Token），如果有下一页，则该字段有返回值。

该参数只要返回值，则说明还有下一页。您可以将返回的NextToken作为请求参数再次获得下一页的数据，直到无返回值，表示获取到了所有的数据
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页个数。取值范围为：1-100，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id
